MainComponents.name: Engine Block
MainComponents.description: Main housing containing cylinders and coolant passages.

MainComponents.name: Cylinder Head
MainComponents.description: Covers cylinders, housing valves and combustion chambers.

MainComponents.name: Crankshaft
MainComponents.description: Converts piston linear motion into rotational power.

MainComponents.name: Camshaft
MainComponents.description: Controls valve timing by rotating in sync with crankshaft.

CombustionComponents.name: Piston
CombustionComponents.description: Moves within cylinder to compress and expand gases.

CombustionComponents.name: Piston Rings
CombustionComponents.description: Seals combustion chamber and controls oil consumption.

CombustionComponents.name: Connecting Rod
CombustionComponents.description: Connects piston to crankshaft and transmits motion.

CombustionComponents.name: Cylinder Liner
CombustionComponents.description: Replaceable sleeve inside engine block for piston travel.

CombustionComponents.name: Valve
CombustionComponents.description: Controls air-fuel intake and exhaust gas release.

CombustionComponents.name: Valve Spring
CombustionComponents.description: Closes the valve after camshaft actuation.

FuelAndAirComponents.name: Fuel Injector
FuelAndAirComponents.description: Sprays atomized fuel into the combustion chamber.

FuelAndAirComponents.name: Fuel Pump
FuelAndAirComponents.description: Supplies fuel from the tank to the injectors.

FuelAndAirComponents.name: Intake Manifold
FuelAndAirComponents.description: Distributes air to each cylinder evenly.

FuelAndAirComponents.name: Air Filter
FuelAndAirComponents.description: Removes dust and particles from incoming air.

FuelAndAirComponents.name: Throttle Body
FuelAndAirComponents.description: Controls airflow into the intake manifold.

LubricationSystem.name: Oil Pump
LubricationSystem.description: Circulates engine oil to lubricate moving parts.

LubricationSystem.name: Oil Pan
LubricationSystem.description: Stores engine oil at the bottom of the engine.

LubricationSystem.name: Oil Pressure Sensor
LubricationSystem.description: Monitors oil pressure and sends signal to ECU.

CoolingSystem.name: Radiator
CoolingSystem.description: Transfers heat from coolant to surrounding air.

CoolingSystem.name: Water Pump
CoolingSystem.description: Circulates coolant through the engine and radiator.

CoolingSystem.name: Thermostat
CoolingSystem.description: Regulates coolant flow to maintain optimal temperature.

CoolingSystem.name: Coolant Temperature Sensor
CoolingSystem.description: Measures coolant temperature for ECU control.

CoolingSystem.name: Cooling Fan
CoolingSystem.description: Draws air through radiator to assist cooling.

ElectronicAndSensorComponents.name: Engine Control Unit (ECU)
ElectronicAndSensorComponents.description: Manages engine operations like fuel, ignition, and emissions.

ElectronicAndSensorComponents.name: Crankshaft Position Sensor
ElectronicAndSensorComponents.description: Detects crankshaft position and speed for ECU timing.

ElectronicAndSensorComponents.name: Camshaft Position Sensor
ElectronicAndSensorComponents.description: Monitors camshaft rotation to control valve timing.

ElectronicAndSensorComponents.name: Oxygen Sensor (Lambda Sensor)
ElectronicAndSensorComponents.description: Monitors exhaust oxygen levels for fuel mixture control.

ElectronicAndSensorComponents.name: Knock Sensor
ElectronicAndSensorComponents.description: Detects engine knocking and sends data to ECU.
